# Port of lib/pubid/oasis/parser.rb: the "OASIS " prefix is stripped and
# the slug captured verbatim; decomposition is builder-side by design.
# parslet `any` is approximated byte-wise (%x01-FF; excludes NUL only).

grammar PubidOasis version "0.1.0" {
  any_char = %x01-FF
  slug = 1*any_char as original
  identifier = "OASIS " slug
  entry identifier: identifier
}
